<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.57.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes 🛠
* [feature] Make Starlette the default server and remove Tornado by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14553
* [chore] Remove deprecated kwargs from `plotly_chart` and `vega_lite_chart` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14800
* [chore] Remove deprecated `_get_websocket_headers` function by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14801
* [feature] Direct polars to arrow conversion bypassing pandas by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14885
### New Features 🎉
* [feature] Hide chevron for menu-style icon labels for `st.menu_button` and `st.popover` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14697
* [feature] Add pills, segmented_control properties and dataframe key to AppTest by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14518
* [feature] Add `title` parameter to alert elements by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14665
* [feat] Add `:shimmer[]` markdown directive for animated loading text by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14055
* [feature] Expose `App` in the `st` namespace by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14722
* Bundle OSS developing-with-streamlit core skills in pip package by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14745
* [fix] Add border radius to video and map elements by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14781
* [feature] Add `secrets` parameter to `st.App` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14861
* Add app and theme templates to bundled skills by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14746
* [feature] Expose `st.bottom` container by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14726
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* [feature] Deduplicate equivalent file extensions in file uploader display by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14552
* [fix] `st.dataframe` crash with pandas 3 ArrowStringArray by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14611
* fix(caching): chain original exception in UnserializableReturnValueError by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14655
* [fix] inconsistent space encoding in query params by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14691
* [fix] Preserve `None` values in `st.data_editor` with pandas 3.0+ by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14694
* [Fix] Add CSS Color Level 4 support by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14674
* [fix] Evict namespace children when watched sources reload by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14708
* [fix] Downcast large Arrow types in custom component v1 serialization by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14617
* [fix] Retain st.radio selection for format_func and custom options by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14815
* Fix bar_chart axis labels not swapping when horizontal=True by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14866
* [fix] st.text_area height='content' sizing on initial load by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14884
### Other Changes
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14576
* [chore] Release v1.56.0 by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14598
* Docs for dataframe programmatic selections by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14616
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14649
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14752
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14869
* Docs for audio and video columns by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14628

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14554
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14655
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14922

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.56.0...1.57.0
